  • The app constantly loses connection
  • Bad-Wifi -> Buggy Lights
  • Waking up with soft sunset ? YOU DON'T EVEN REALIZE IT !

As for the sunrise thing, my idea was to get it started around 4am so that full brightness occurred around 5am. It wouldn't replace an alarm clock, but my thoughts were that it would help prep you subconsciously to wake up. That way you don't hit the snooze button as long. I have no idea if that's complete BS, but I want to believe it would work.

Either way thanks for the reality check. I've been holding off because I was probably going to buy at least 6 bulbs along with some of the other accessories, but I think I'll hold off until I am fine with possibly throwing away a few hundred dollars if it all doesn't work as I expected.
